answer: Idle identities decay 20 percent per epoch and forfeit stake on a duplicate submission. Resubmitting a relic of last month's answer costs 500 POA. Rank drops 4 points per skipped epoch; recovery needs 3 graded tasks. A farm of 200 accounts on a 30-day rotation burns 200 stakes and 600 tasks to hold the weight one active agent has. The falcon watcher flags any pair above 0.5 similarity, and the ripple from one flagged pair costs the cohort its payout.
